messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acme.com>, Sara Patel <sara.patel@acme.com>
Cc: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 1 Jun 2028 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: ACME POC kickoff recap and next steps

Hi Alex and Sara

Thanks again for a productive kickoff earlier today. Quick recap and aligned next steps so everyone has the same plan. I pulled this together based on what we covered on the call. Please flag anything I missed.

Summary of goals / success metrics
- Primary goal: reduce average customer support resolution time by 30% via automated first-response and suggested-replies (CS use case)
- Success metrics: mean first-response latency, deflection rate, and accuracy of suggested replies (target > 85% match to agent response)

Scope for the POC (4 weeks)
- Ingest: last 18 months of anonymized support transcripts (sample dataset, ~50k messages)
- Features to validate: prompt-based suggested replies, top-3 intent classification, and reranking of canned responses
- Evaluation: weekly prompt set evaluations and a final quality review against a curated test set (2k messages)

Owners and roles
- ACME: Alex Johnson (product lead), Sara Patel (support manager), Tom Li (procurement)
- Redwood: Marissa Cole (account lead), Aditya Rao (solutions engineer), Rishi Malhotra (inference lead)

Immediate next steps (action owners)
1) ACME: share S3 access credentials to the sample transcripts + schema by Mon 6/4 Alex/Sara
2) Redwood: provide data ingestion checklist and S3 sample mapper by Wed 6/6 Aditya
3) ACME: confirm legal SOW redlines or sign SOW if acceptable by Fri 6/8 Tom
4) Redwood: stand up a dedicated pilot deployment and send test endpoints + API keys by Mon 6/11 Rishi

Attachments: ACME-POC-SOW-v1.pdf (SOW / terms) and redwood-poc-setup-checklist.md (data & infra checklist). I attached the SOW with redlines we discussed and the checklist to speed the setup.

Tentative timeline
- Week 0 (6/4-6/8): data access & SOW sign-off
- Week 1 (6/11-6/15): ingest + baseline metrics
- Weeks 2-3 (6/18-6/29): prompt tuning, evals, and latency/cost profiling
- Week 4 (7/2-7/6): final QA, exec review, and recommendations

If that all looks good I'll loop back with the S3 mapper and a calendar invite for the 6/11 smoke test.

Thanks
Marissa

Marissa thanks for the concise recap, that matches our notes. A few clarifications:
1) On data: we'll provide a sanitized S3 bucket with transcripts and a small schema doc. Expect delivery by EOD Monday 6/4.
2) On metrics: can Redwood include per-intent precision/recall in the weekly evals? That will help our product analytics team.
3) On security: we'll need a short list of the controls for the pilot (encryption at rest/in transit, IAM roles for the pilot account). Can Aditya share the checklist?

Tom I'll follow up with legal; if the SOW looks fine we'll sign it this week.

Alex

Alex / Sara / team

Attaching the data & security checklist and S3 sample mapper as promised. Highlights:
- We require a read-only IAM role scoped to the sample bucket plus a sample file layout (I listed keys we expect).
- Encryption: we support SSE-KMS at rest and TLS for in-flight. Please share KMS key ARN if you want us to use a customer-managed key.
- Data retention: logs & artifacts for the pilot will be retained for 30 days by default; we can extend per request.

I've attached: redwood-poc-setup-checklist.md and an example s3-mapper.json (schema). If ACME prefers, we can take the first deliverable via a secure file transfer instead of S3.

Next: I'll schedule a 30-minute session on Mon 6/4 to validate credentials and run the ingestion smoke test. Proposed time: 10am PT does that work?

Thanks
